title: GOHL: Lincolns win three times in four nights, Meteor shower in Stratford
excerpt: Western Division-leading St. Marys improved to 17-1.
content:
Blake Elzinga had two goals and Owen Bruining scored and added three assists to power St. Marys to a 6-1 win at Listowel on Sunday.

The Western Division-leadings Lincolns won their 16th game in a row.

James McGregor, Christopher Mabey and Ethan Weir added goals for the Lincolns (17-1).

Shayne Keefe had the lone goal for the third place Cyclones (11-5-3-0).

Elzinga scored the winner deep into the third period of the Lincolns’ 6-5 win at Chatham on Friday night.

Devun Colebrook, Michael Pope, Campbell Lehto, Ryan Hodkinson and Bruining also scored for the Lincolns.

Santiago Jimenes had a hat trick for the fourth place Maroons (12-5-0-0). Andrew Baker and Matteo Mosca also scored.

The Lincolns used a balanced attack in their 5-1 last Thursday (Nov. 5) over Sarnia Legionnaires.

Owen Miniotas, Callum McAuley, Pole, Lehto and Weir scored for the Lincolns.

Declan Haltaufderhyde had the goal for the last place Legionnaires (1-15).

Warriors humbled by Meteors 

Fort Erie Meteors went down 1-0 against Stratford on Friday night but ripped off five straight goals en route to a 7-2 win over the Warriors.

Tate Donald scored three times for the Meteors (14-1-1), currently in third place in a very competitive Eastern Division.

Aiden Zimmerman added two goals. Easton Poirier and Hudson Ellis also scored for the Meteors.

Mateo Craievich and Colin Slattery scored for the fifth place Warriors (9-5-0-1).

Also Friday, Thomas Paleczny scored twice to pace Listowel to a 6-2 win over London Nationals.

Trent Houghton, Clark deBoer, Lyndon Cabral and Keefe added goals for the Cyclones.

Sebastian Dos Reis and Nicholas Kiss scored for eighth place London (7-11-1-0).
